nodes.text: [i]Inside the flame, it is always the same afternoon.[/i]
[i]The lantern remembers more than you do. Press [R], walk somewhere, and press [R] again: a ghost of you will play it back and then stand where it ended.[/i]
[i]A remembered you has weight. It can hold a plate down, and the curious are drawn to it. You can keep two.[/i]
